audit.why: Content layer frames the lane correctly: Vex-favoured at every stage against an immobile mage whose whole threat is landing Sear while you are ablaze; his danger moves to grouped teamfights. 52.67% WR over 1069 games supports the Vex lean.

Spikes are sound: 3-5 dodge-and-punish window, level 6 R pick on a dash-less target vs a Pyroclasm that needs allies to bounce, first-item all-in through W shield, late grouped-fight danger. Ability names all real (Sear, Pillar of Flame, Conflagration, Pyroclasm).

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart says 'Skill' on all 7 rows while content win[] and the packet both say Vex on all 7. Several full-layer strings are dash-templated ('every trade he answers with a dash', 'the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast') against a champion with zero dashes — Vex's passive anti-dash tools are irrelevant into Brand and the text must not pretend otherwise. Cooldowns field had no digit. Two Do's/Don'ts bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim.
audit.why: Brand has no mobility at all; the decisive interaction is Blaze: Sear stuns only while ablaze, Pillar deals +25% to ablaze targets. Trading text keyed to enemy dashes is factually wrong here.
audit.corrected: Chart moved to Vex on all rows with grounded whys; tradeGood/tradeBad/trading rewritten around the Blaze-Sear stun condition with real cooldowns (Q 8s, W 10s, R 100/90/80).
